messages.subject: Error in Deployment
parts:
My code works fine to run the app through RStudio, but when I try to deploy the app to shinyapps.io, I get the following error where my plot should be:

An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification.

Everything else on the page shows up (my slider bar, radio buttons, checkboxes, etc), but the plot itself is missing. Any idea what causes this issue?

I have tried the following:
-deleting the rsconnect folder from my directory
-uploading separte ui.r and server.r files
-using the manual delpoyApp command (instead of the "publish" button on the page) although I couldn't understand what I should put for appSourceDoc=

Keep in mind, this is my first project on shiny and I am very new to it, I don't understand a lot of the coding jargon. Also, my version of RStudio allows the "shiny" package, but not "shinyapps", I don't know if that is relevant. 

Here is some of the code I have tried:
library(rsconnect)
deployApp(appDir = getwd(), appFiles = "ui.r", "server.r", appName = "gapminder-davisfinal2", appSourceDoc = "306 final")

Any suggestions would be appreciated!
